git_commit_semantics: Exact tested committed implementation; later evidence-only commit may save this record.

particle1_manual_review_evidence.scope: User accepted the Particle-1 report, machine record and eight figures in the current chat. Historical per-run data remains unchanged.

literature_sources.verification_method: Read primary article tables from Europe PMC fullTextXML (Moss) and PMC HTML (Rivera, De Franceschi); retain bibliographic/numeric metadata only, not full papers.

sources.title: Role of channels in the O2 permeability of murine red blood cells II. Morphological and proteomic studies
sources.model_usage: Use Table 3 mean/SD as a Normal approximation and Table 4 mean MCV as volume anchor. Do not use 2.6 fL as single-cell SD. Table 4 RDW is not the chosen V0 CV.

sources.title: Strain-specific variations in cation content and transport in mouse erythrocytes
sources.authors: Rivera A, Zee RYL, Alper SL, Peters LL, Brugnara C
sources.model_usage: Cross-check the scale of the selected 47.9 fL anchor; do not pool substrains or infer joint cell-level D/V.

sources.title: Evidence for a protective role of the Gardos channel against hemolysis in murine spherocytosis
sources.authors: De Franceschi L, Rivera A, Fleming MD, Honczarenko M, Peters LL, Gascard P, Mohandas N, Brugnara C
sources.model_usage: Context for MCV and RDW scale; 14.8% is a user-approved modeling choice, not this table's measured RDW.

volume_cv_model_choice.note: Do not attribute an exact 14.8% estimate to the diameter dataset. Retrieved studies report differing RDW (13.2% and 17.3%); V0 is provisional and does not equate substrains or instruments.

diameter_model: Normal approximation to reported C57BL/6Case single-cell diameter statistics
volume_model: Normal V0 approximation; MCV anchor plus user-selected CV
